art_direction: 浅贝壳底，柔金细长弧眼；自然收尖，瞳孔完整收在眼形内。
composition_variation: Two clean slender crescent-almond eyes use continuous supple curved contours, drawing on the paired gold-eye reference. Each opening is about 3.1 times wider than tall. The two outer corners taper naturally into fine short tips; the inner corners remain gentle, so the pair never forms an angry V. Keep them almost level, with only 5 percent scale difference. Large black pupil forms stay completely within the eye outline and join the upper boundary, with one single amber iris crescent along the lower arc. The crescent gradually thins at both ends and is not a U-shaped cup. Both pupils look calmly forward and contain one subtle narrow ivory glint. No upper eyeliner wing, eyelash flick, eyebrows or other features. Matte flat fill, precise flowing edges, no shine, protruding pupil, droplet or geometric cut.
visible_subject: exactly two eye graphics; no other animal features
